Note.title: Note
Note.description: A study note or summary created by a student or tutor.

content.description: Full markdown or text content of the note

price.description: Listing price for the note in USD (0 for free)

isPublic.description: Whether the note is published to the public marketplace

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when note was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when note was last modified

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: A demo purchase receipt granting access to a paid study note.

id.description: Unique identifier of the purchase record

buyerId.description: UID of the student purchasing the note

title.description: Title of the note at time of purchase

/notes/{noteId}.description: Collection of notes owned by students, readable publicly when isPublic is true.

/purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Collection of demo purchases, readable only by buyer or seller.
